These synthetic 1.18.0 packages and expected fields were generated by the independent T437 review using the unchanged Markdown and note formatter from commit 10a9733. They cover the unweighted-list and four-section GUID regressions, plus the bold-list control.

`cases.json` is the exact imported content and the old HTML/GUID. The ordinary Rust suite compares those values with the current formatter. The optional native regression creates new packages with the current formatter, then imports old/old/new/new into three private temporary Anki collections. It checks both note and card counts and never opens a user profile.

Run with a Python interpreter that can import the native Anki package:

```sh
ANKI_PYTHON=/absolute/python cargo test --test all review_f1_native -- --ignored --nocapture
```

When using an installed Anki application, set `PYTHONPATH` to its bundled `app_packages` and use its matching Python version. The test bounds the child process to 60 seconds and removes its collections via the Rust temporary directory.
